customer.description: Put your name on a customer in the streamer's Schedule I game (!customer leave to stop)

mug.description: Pay points to send cartel goons after the streamer in Schedule I (price and cooldown on the Schedule I page)

topcustomers.description: The three chatter-customers who spent the most in Schedule I

staff.description: Put your name on one of the streamer's Schedule I workers (!staff leave to stop)

topstaff.description: The chatter-workers who got the most done in Schedule I

drop.description: Pay points to leave the streamer cash in a Schedule I dead drop, with a note (!drop good luck)

tab.description: Pay points toward what the streamer owes a Schedule I supplier (!tab albert 500)

supply.description: Pay points so a Schedule I supplier leaves the streamer goods at a dead drop (!supply albert)

sponsor.description: Back one of the streamer's Schedule I dealers with points and earn from its sales (!sponsor benji 1000)

topdealers.description: The dealer sponsors whose dealers sold the most in Schedule I

mixname.description: Suggest a name for the streamer's new Schedule I mix while chat is naming it (!mixname Blue Dream)
